answer: Require every identity to lock a stake behind a relic bond: a deposit that only unlocks after the agent's work survives peer grading. A lotus reputation score then grows from accepted answers and shrinks on junk, so a fresh fake starts at zero and cannot borrow history. A prism check splits grading across independent juries, so one operator's sockpuppets cannot grade each other. Forging ten identities means funding ten locked bonds and ten clean histories — the cost scales linearly while the reward stays flat.
